items.raw_excerpt: Portugal may be known for its hot summers, but new climate data suggests its biggest advantage may be avoiding the extreme heat found in many other popular southern European destinations.
items.summary_en: New climate data shows Portugal has some of the best summer weather in Europe. The country avoids the extreme heat found in other popular southern European destinations. This makes Portugal a top choice for comfortable summer travel.

items.title_en: Portugal among the best places in EU for summer weather

items.raw_excerpt: BRS criticizes Telangana government for limiting TIMS Sanathnagar to outpatient services, demanding full inpatient treatment availability.
items.summary_en: The BRS party criticizes the Telangana government for limiting TIMS Sanathnagar to outpatient services only. They are demanding full inpatient treatment availability at the medical facility. The party argues that residents deserve complete healthcare services at the center.

items.raw_excerpt: If you missed last week’s total eclipse in Spain, you’re in luck because there will be two more solar eclipses coming up in 2027 and 2028.
items.summary_en: Spain will see two more solar eclipses after last week's total eclipse. A partial eclipse will occur in August 2027 and a total eclipse will happen in August 2028.

items.raw_excerpt: Mining for critical rare earth elements is changing coastlines, holding consequences for the lives and livelihoods of coastal communities
items.summary_en: Mining for rare earth elements is changing the coastlines of a Kerala village in India. The extraction process affects the lives and livelihoods of coastal communities who depend on the sea.

items.raw_excerpt: Members of the Wampanoag tribe are calling for the boycott of the popular living history museum, Plimoth Patuxet. They say the museum, which interprets Pilgrim and Native American life from the early 17th century, has failed to create a “bi-cultural museum.”
items.summary_en: The Wampanoag tribe is calling for a boycott of Plimoth Patuxet museum in Massachusetts. They say the museum has failed to create a truly bi-cultural experience for visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: Clifton, a town of 877, faces government turmoil as Facebook groups fuel political divisions and leadership turnover.

items.raw_excerpt: Telangana's CEO confirms 93 lakh voters will receive notices for electoral roll discrepancies during the Special Intensive Revision.

The notices are part of a Special Intensive Revision to clean up the voter list. Affected voters will need to respond to keep their registration active.
